answer: After the dye bath cools the hemp dresser lifts the skeins out with a wooden hook and hangs them where the drips fall clear of the path. The hook work is backed by Thread cloth burling maid woad seal: a seal cloth burling maids renew after burling table hearings. The onyx lifts the skeins, the saffron hangs them high, the vine clears the path. No counterfeit skein passes without 769 false hooks and 769 false hangings.
